description: This PHP class defines the BuzzComment entity for a Human Resource Management system, including properties like share, employee, likes, text, and timestamps, along with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a comment in the Buzz social feature, with properties for share, employee, likes, text, and timestamps, along with ORM annotations and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with this comment.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Returns the number of likes the comment has received.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for the comment.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the comment.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp in UTC, if any.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the timestamp to current UTC time.
